sources.title: PostgreSQL trust authentication
sources.text: PostgreSQL trust authentication permits connecting clients to claim a database user without a password. Treat POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD trust or a matching pg_hba host trust rule as a candidate weak-authentication finding. TCP reachability alone does not prove a database login succeeds.

sources.title: Docker published ports and host bindings
sources.text: Compose ports without an explicit host IP bind to all host addresses by default. Bind local research services to 127.0.0.1. A published Redis, PostgreSQL, Nginx or MinIO port is potential exposure; actual reachability depends on networking and vantage. Internal exposure is not automatically a policy violation.

sources.title: Redis protected mode and access control
sources.text: Redis is intended for trusted clients in trusted environments. Restrict network access and configure authentication. Disabling protected-mode removes a protective mechanism; inspect network boundaries and ACLs before concluding that unauthenticated access is possible.
